notes: Scenario, slippage and gap figures were authored on 2026-09-19 against a different book (GOOGL 200 closed; MSFT 200 opened; SNOW 100 opened; UNG 2000 -> 3500). Treat those rows as indicative until they are re-derived; the positions, stops, vol, VaR and budget meters above are live.

Scenario, slippage and gap figures were authored on 2026-09-19 at GOOGL $352.00, UNG $10.39 and prices have since moved 7.1%. Treat those rows as indicative until they are re-derived; the positions, stops, vol, VaR and budget meters above are live.
NAV is $300,000 throughout - the notional mandate assigned by the firm. Never measured against account equity, by instruction. 1% = $3,000.
Limits are provisional, set 15 Sep 2026: 2% maximum loss per theme, 6% across the portfolio. Not a written company risk policy.
Themes are assigned, not fed. IBKR returns no sector tags; every theme in this file is a stated assumption.

Stop distances are shown as probability of being touched over a holding period, not in daily sigma - these are GTC orders with no expiry. The probability is the reflection-principle first-passage estimate 2*Phi(-ln(S/B)/(sigma*sqrt(T))) on realised daily vol, zero drift.

Stops are the account's GTC working orders, read through the IBKR connector when the board is refreshed in session; the unattended daily run carries the last read forward, because an IBKR Activity Flex Query cannot report working orders. Where a position has more than one stop, the nearest one drives the touch probabilities and the dollar risk sums every tranche. Still unconfirmed: whether they are enabled outside regular trading hours - most gaps occur overnight, which is exactly when a stop is least likely to help.
Parametric VaR understates the tail: the historical 5th percentile has run above the parametric figure, and the worst day in the window was roughly 1.5x the 99% VaR.
Correlation between the two legs is not a usable parameter - the standard error is wide and the rolling 20-day figure has swung through zero in both directions.
Scenario betas are assumed: UNG ~1.0 to front-month gas. The XOP terms were removed with the position on 23 Sep 2026.
Scenario, slippage and gap figures are authored at the prices in price_basis and do not move with the market. The tab flags them when live prices drift past tolerance.
